content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Lawton

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—but no prior work experience. If you hold a high school diploma or higher and are ready to formalize your PM knowledge, you qualify to begin immediately.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Hours of PM Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, learn from active certified practitioners, and earn your required contact hours on a schedule that fits your Lawton work and life.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, create your PMI account and submit your CAPM application with proof of your education hours. Pay the associated exam fee directly to PMI to activate your testing eligibility.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources to review PMBOK® Guide content and practice questions. Schedule your CAPM exam through PMI's testing partner and complete your assessment on your own timeline.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: CAPM credentials renew every three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through approved training, volunteer work, or publications to keep your certification active and demonstrate ongoing mastery of project management.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?
fq_items.answer: Yes. The CAPM is one of the most recognized entry-level PM credentials and is highly regarded across industries in {city_state}. It demonstrates PM knowledge to employers even before you have years of experience.

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.

fq_items.question: Is this training delivered online?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Our CAPM training is fully live-virtual — no travel required. {city} students attend via video conference from wherever they are.
